title: json.dumps fails and price comparisons stop matching after stripe-python v15 returns Decimal
symptoms: TypeError: Object of type Decimal is not JSON serializable
Type checker rejects a str passed as unit_amount_decimal
cause: v15 maps every decimal formatted field, in responses and in request params, to Python Decimal instead of str.
fix: Serialize with to_dict(for_json=True), compare against Decimal values, and pass Decimal when setting these fields.
apply:
from decimal import Decimal
payload = json.dumps(price.to_dict(for_json=True))
if price.unit_amount_decimal == Decimal("9.99"):
    ...
